sources.snippet: Confucius4-R2T2 is NetEase Youdao's streaming speech recognition model, built on Qwen3-ASR-1.7B (2.04 B parameters). A 24-layer audio encoder feeds a 28-layer Qwen3 language model, which writes language <name><asr_text><transcript>. The model is optimized for Chinese and English and lists 30 languages. sources.snippet: Confucius4-R2T2 is a low-latency and high-accuracy true streaming Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model that features fine-grained and configurable decoding chunks from 80 ms to 2 s.
